newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian troops put on standby over PNG crisis.
newsitem.headline: Australian troops put on standby over PNG crisis.

text.p: Australian troops have been placed on standby in case the crisis in neighbouring Papua New Guinea worsened, a government official said on Friday.

"It's a state of increased readiness," a spokesman for Defence Minister Ian McLachlan said. He said some elements of Australia's military had been placed on increased readiness as "a sensible precaution" from Thursday, but the move did not reflect a decision to deploy troops.
"It is a sensible precaution in light of developments in PNG over the past couple of days," he said.
The spokesman would not say which units were on increased alert or make any further comment.

Papua New Guinea has been rocked by widespread civil strife after a split between the army and the over the Prime Minister Sir Julius Chan's plan to use mercenaries to quell an island rebellion. There are several thousand Australians in Papua New Guinea, Australia's closest neighbour.
